> **What you can defend when you leave.** Decide whether this work is ready to leave your hands, and say what the next study should be.

## The milestone ahead {#checkpoint}

Every research cycle ends with two decisions no tool can make for you: whether this work is ready to leave your hands, and what should be asked next. This milestone runs the release audit, closes your dossier and your AI ledger as complete records, and writes the stopping rule you can say aloud. It is the last milestone, and it produces what the other eleven were building toward: your finished research artifact, released, defended, and pointing at its successor.

This studio closes with **[Milestone 12: Your release and next cycle](milestone12-release-next-cycle.qmd)**, a short chapter of its own after the lessons. **What it asks you to produce.** A release audit, your final dossier, an explicit stopping rule, and your next-study agenda.

This is where the chain closes. The artifact leaves your hands, and the next-study agenda opens the cycle that follows. The milestone chapter keeps the working details: the practice steps, the versioned record, and how the artifact is assessed.

## The lessons in this studio

Read them in order, working each lesson's **It is your turn** as you go. Each one builds a piece of Milestone 12; beside each lesson is the piece it hands you.

- [Lesson 37 — Managing Multiple AI Agents](https://davi-moreira.github.io/2026F_evidence_driven_research_purdue_HONR464/book/part6-after-conference/35-managing-multiple-ai-agents.html): if you ran agent loops: your three-loop round with its wiring, its turn counts, and the one node you kept human.
- [Lesson 38 — Conflicting Agents and Human Escalation](https://davi-moreira.github.io/2026F_evidence_driven_research_purdue_HONR464/book/part6-after-conference/36-conflicting-agents-and-human-escalation.html): if your loops disagreed: your escalation rules, one conflict diagnosed and resolved by your own check, and the override on record.
- [Lesson 39 — Final Research and AI-Management Portfolio](https://davi-moreira.github.io/2026F_evidence_driven_research_purdue_HONR464/book/part6-after-conference/37-final-research-and-ai-management-portfolio.html): your finished research artifact with every claim bounded, your four-part AI-management portfolio, and the rehearsed three-movement defense.

When the last lesson closes, the milestone chapter is next. Nothing you write in a lesson is busywork: every piece above is on the milestone's checklist.
